title: HALLELUJAH, HOME AT LAST!
author: Eleanor Wright
stanzas: Hallelujah, home at last The redeemed are home at last! All heaven is filled with happiness For the age of sin is past See the gates as they open open wide See the saints as they walk inside singing, hallelujah, home at last The redeemed are home at last!

Hallelujah, all day I can hear the angels sing suddenly I hear Moses" song And the angels fold their wings See the Lamb as He beckons me Hear Him say, "Come and dine with Me!" Singing, hallelujah, home at last The redeemed are home at last!
